steps.description: The current page is about:blank with no interactive elements, so we must first navigate to the OKX Web3 homepage as specified in the user goal. The previous navigate attempt failed because it lacked a target. Providing the correct URL will load the page, after which we can continue with the required clicks.

The user wants to open the OKX Web3 homepage (already done) and then click the '行情' link in the top-left navigation. On the current screen, the element with ID hexa-2 is an <a> with text '行情' and likely corresponds to the left top navigation link. Clicking it will proceed to the next step.

The user wants to open the detail page of the first token after the '行情' page loaded. On the current token list screen, the first token link is the element with ID hexa-43 (text='Punch'). Clicking this will navigate to the token's detail page, which is the next required step.

We are on the token detail page after clicking the first coin (Punch). The next step in the user goal is to check the '我已知晓交易风险' checkbox before starting a trade. The label element for this checkbox is present as hexa-148. Clicking the label should toggle the checkbox.

The user wants to proceed after acknowledging the trading risk. The next step in the goal sequence is to click the "开始交易" button to start trading. The current screen shows a button with text "开始交易" having ID hexa-149. Clicking this will move us to the next step (connecting the wallet).
The user wants to connect the wallet after starting the trade. On the current page, there is a button with text "连接钱包" identified as hexa-160. Clicking this button completes the next required step.
